    captchaRequired.value = true
    captchaUuid.value = 'demo'
    captchaImage.value = ''
    captchaCode.value = ''
    return
  }
  captchaLoading.value = true
  try {
    const payload = await fetchLoginCaptcha()
    captchaRequired.value = payload.enabled
    captchaUuid.value = payload.uuid ?? ''
    captchaImage.value = payload.imageDataUrl ?? ''
    captchaCode.value = ''
  } catch (cause) {
    captchaRequired.value = true
    captchaUuid.value = ''
    captchaImage.value = ''
    error.value = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : '验证码加载失败'
  } finally {
    captchaLoading.value = false
  }
}

onMounted(() => { if (isRemote) void refreshCaptcha() })

function switchMode() {

  error.value = ''
  mode.value = mode.value === 'verify' ? 'password' : 'verify'

  if (smsCountdown.value > 0) return
  if (!/^1\d{10}$/.test(phone.value.trim())) { error.value = '请输入正确的11位手机号码'; return }
  error.value = ''
  if (isRemote) {
    error.value = '短信验证码接口未开放，请使用密码登录'
    return
  }
  smsCountdown.value = 60
  smsTimer = setInterval(() => {
    smsCountdown.value -= 1
    if (smsCountdown.value <= 0 && smsTimer) { clearInterval(smsTimer); smsTimer = null }
  }, 1000)
}

async function submit() {
  if (loading.value) return
  error.value = ''
  if (mode.value === 'verify') {
    if (!/^1\d{10}$/.test(phone.value.trim())) { error.value = '请输入正确的11位手机号码'; return }
    if (!/^\d{4}$/.test(idTail.value.trim())) { error.value = '请输入身份证号后四位'; return }
    if (!smsCode.value.trim()) { error.value = '请输入验证码'; return }
  } else {
    if (!user.value.trim()) { error.value = '请输入账号'; return }
    if (!pwd.value) { error.value = '请输入密码'; return }
  }
  if (captchaRequired.value && mode.value === 'password') {
    if (!captchaCode.value.trim()) { error.value = '请输入图形验证码'; return }
    if (!captchaUuid.value) { error.value = '验证码已失效，请点击图片刷新'; return }
  }
  if (!agreement.value) { error.value = '请勾选同意用户协议和隐私协议'; return }

  loading.value = true
  try {
    if (mode.value === 'verify') {
      if (isRemote) throw new Error('验证码登录接口未开放，请使用密码登录')
      // 演示模式：直接进入

    } else {

        : undefined
      await useFloodStore().login(user.value.trim(), pwd.value, captcha)
      uni.reLaunch({ url: '/pages/systems/index' })

  } catch (cause) {
    error.value = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : '登录失败，请重试'
